definitions.name: FreshBooks Get Identity
definitions.documentation: One bounded FreshBooks GET /auth/api/v1/users/me. Explicit accountId for accounting routes; numeric businessId for projects/timetracking/comments; businessUuid for current ledger trial balance. Identity discovery preserves membership, business, account and UUID identities separately. External OAuth bearer RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken or FRESHBOOKS_ACCESS_TOKEN/named secret only; RuntimeConnection.config merges node settings. Required numeric $retries=0; no automatic retries, pagination, token flows, ambient accounts, arbitrary URL or redirects. All mutations require confirmMutation=true; financial/item/project/rate mutations also confirmFinancial=true. Invoices are drafts; separate Mark Invoice Sent changes accounting recognition without emailing. Payment writes record external payments and force notifications false; they never initiate charges. Updates send only supplied known fields; line arrays replace the provider collection, so reconcile the latest complete lines before sending. Service rate create/update must use the correct existing rate state; never retry uncertain writes. Exact decimal money/quantity/rate/tax strings retain every digit and trailing zero; numeric provider values for these fields are rejected. Known-field response projection deliberately omits undeclared private data. One page of <=100 resources; reports <=1000 rows and <=366 days, no report downloads. GET project/time requests omit Content-Type. Total Date.now deadline starts before profile/secret loading and covers request validation, transport, fatal UTF-8 decode, typed projection, return and cleanup:100–30000ms,256KiB requests,1MiB responses,16384 nonempty fragments,depth30/100000 values. No delete/archive/email/attachment/timer listener or provider verification. Provider OAuth scopes, business role, entitlements, locale, currency and valid relationships remain prerequisites.
